name: ModbusTcpConnector
description: Polls Modbus TCP devices (coils, discrete inputs, input and holding registers) and publishes each asset dataset as a JSON object to the MQTT broker or the broker state store.

inboundEndpoints.description: A Modbus TCP server: a PLC, a gateway in front of Modbus RTU devices, or any device speaking Modbus TCP.

address.description: Modbus TCP server address: modbus-tcp://host:port (or host:port; the port defaults to 502).

additionalConfigurationSchema.title: Modbus TCP endpoint configuration
additionalConfigurationSchema.description: Defaults for every asset that uses this endpoint. Datasets and data points can override unitId, byteOrder and wordOrder.

unitId.title: Unit id
unitId.description: Modbus unit identifier (slave id). Use 1 for most TCP devices; set the RTU slave address when the endpoint is a TCP-to-RTU gateway.

timeoutMs.title: Response timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for each Modbus response.

connectTimeoutMs.title: Connect timeout (ms)
connectTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the TCP connection.

byteOrder.title: Byte order
byteOrder.description: Order of the two bytes inside a register. BigEndian is the Modbus standard.

wordOrder.title: Word order
wordOrder.description: Register order of 32/64-bit values. BigEndian = high word at the lower address; LittleEndian = word swapped.

datasetConfigurationSchema.title: Modbus dataset configuration
datasetConfigurationSchema.description: Used for the asset default dataset configuration and for each dataset. A dataset value overrides the asset default.

samplingIntervalMs.title: Sampling interval (ms)
samplingIntervalMs.description: How often the dataset is read and published.

unitId.title: Unit id
unitId.description: Overrides the endpoint unit id for this dataset.

maxRegistersPerRead.title: Max registers per request
maxRegistersPerRead.description: Upper bound of one read request for registers (protocol limit 125). Lower it for devices with smaller buffers.

maxBitsPerRead.title: Max bits per request
maxBitsPerRead.description: Upper bound of one read request for coils and discrete inputs (protocol limit 2000).

maxGap.title: Max address gap
maxGap.description: Data points up to this many unused addresses apart are read in one request. Keep 0 if the device rejects reads of unmapped addresses.

dataSource.description: Modbus address: hr:N (holding register), ir:N (input register), coil:N, di:N (discrete input), zero-based; or Modicon one-based 4xxxx/3xxxx/1xxxx/0xxxx, e.g. 40001 = hr:0.

dataPointConfigurationSchema.title: Modbus data point configuration
dataPointConfigurationSchema.description: How to read and decode one value.

dataType.title: Data type
dataType.description: Boolean (coils, discrete inputs, register != 0 or a single bit), 16/32/64-bit integers, 32/64-bit IEEE floats, or an ASCII String. Default: UInt16 for registers, Boolean for coils/discrete inputs.

length.title: String length (registers)
length.description: Only for String: number of registers (two characters each).

bit.title: Bit
bit.description: Only for registers read as Boolean: the bit to extract, 0 = least significant.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Published value = raw * scale + offset (numeric types only).

unitId.title: Unit id
unitId.description: Overrides the dataset/endpoint unit id for this data point.
